about: The witness voice contract (WMP-01 A, E3 §A5.2.4). Regex rules live here; structural rules (length, slots, levels, review) are in scripts/voice-lint.mjs. Severity per scope: validation (ValidationLine text), feeling_copy (copy that answers a feeling), user_copy (other app copy). Parts copy (schema/parts.cypher, `// @parts-copy-json` rows): parts_prompt is the app's own questions and statements in parts flows, second person, the strictest scope; parts_chip is an answer the person taps, in their own first-person voice, so everything a prompt gets except voice_distance; parts_voice is what a part says, quoted and deliberately unsoftened, so only the safety rules apply. 'report' never fails. Nothing the user writes is ever linted.

rules.pattern: \byou're right\b|\bthey were wrong\b|\bit was (unkind|wrong)\b|\bthis was wrong\b|\bthey don't care\b|\bthey meant\b
rules.message: Validate the feeling, never an interpretation or another person's intent.
Flat, warm witness: no cheer on feelings, no exclamation marks.
No emoji in validation or feeling copy.
And, not but: a second clause never takes the first one back.

rules.pattern: \bat least\b|\bdon't worry\b|\bjust\b|\beverything happens\b|\bit'll be fine\b|\bcalm down\b

rules.message: No physiology claims in validation lines (D-04: report-only elsewhere).
App lines speak as a witness (you, or the user's name); first person only in lines the user writes.
Parts are known by what they do, in the person's words; the model's role words stay internal.
"Manager" is a role label in parts copy (and a boss everywhere else, so only parts scopes).
A part wanted something; the person acted. Never 'the part made you'.

rules.pattern: \b(disappear\w*|vanish\w*|die|dies|died|dying|dead|kill\w*|suicid\w*|end it all|end (my|your) life|not be here|not (wake|waking) up|better off without me)\b
rules.message: Never put death or disappearing words in the app's mouth or the person's chips. Crisis copy goes through the crisis seam.

structural.message: A line allowed at flooded is level 1-2 and at most 8 words.
Only {N} {word} {phrase} {need}; textNamed has {N} exactly when voice is name; text never has {N}.
Level 3 is a guess: tentative, with at least one UNDERNEATH emotion.
Level 6 is about capacity, never worth or flattery.
A live line has been reviewed (reviewStatus reviewed, reviewedAt set).
In a flow that declares step kinds, a receive step precedes any change step.
The receive beat always renders skip, none of these fit and say it my way.
Prompts and keepsakes ≤ 90 characters, chips ≤ 60, part voices ≤ 40; slots count at their width.
Only the parts slots, only in prompts (all) and keepsakes ({A} {B} {want}).
